formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x4, ↑x5) ∈ List.flatMap (fun (x6 : ℕ) => [(x6, (21 : ℕ) + (x6 + (20 : ℕ)) % (21 : ℕ)), (x6, (21 : ℕ) + x6), (x6, (21 : ℕ) + (x6 + (5 : ℕ)) % (21 : ℕ)), (x6, (21 : ℕ) + (x6 + (7 : ℕ)) % (21 : ℕ)), (x6, (21 : ℕ) + (x6 + (17 : ℕ)) % (21 : ℕ))]) (List.range (21 : ℕ)) ∧ x3 x4 = Bool.true ∧ x3 x5 = Bool.true) → (104 : ℕ) ≤ {x4 : Fin x1.gates.length | (x1.gates.get x4).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or}.ncard
plain_statement: Plane of order 4 as in the parent (points 0 to 20, lines 21 to 41, 105 incident pairs): every AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two computing incidence on the 42 inputs has at least 104 OR gates.
title: A step toward: No circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates computes the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4
